subject: Interim geo-escrow notice — temporary outbound hop and evidence timeline
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Interim geo-escrow notice — temporary outbound hop and evidence timeline

Hi Emma —

Quick heads-up on an operational window that will affect routing for a small subset of HealthSync traffic next week. During a scheduled capacity reshuffle on our EU pool we will need to apply a short-lived outbound hop to our US analytics cluster for certain background telemetry and cache warming. Key details below: 

- What: transient outbound hop (EU -> US) for background telemetry and cache sync only — not full customer payload routing.
- When: 2028-06-08 03:00–04:30 UTC (90 minutes max) — we will not process new requests through the hop after the window ends.
- Scope: only requests flagged by the cache-fanout job for session prefetching; PII is redacted before the hop by defaulting to hashed identifiers.
- Controls: traffic will use TLS, will not persist on the US cluster beyond the maintenance window, and will be subject to our standard log retention policy for transient telemetry (30 days).

I have attached a short ops runbook and a routing diagram for the window and included a draft DPA addendum that documents the temporary exception. We want to make sure HealthSync is comfortable with the approach and to collect any required acceptance or evidence requests from your side (subprocessor roster, KMS treatment questions, etc.).

Attachments: ops-runbook.pdf (pdf), routing-diagram.png (png), pinning_addendum_draft.docx (docx)

Request: please confirm by EOD Tue 2028-06-02 if this window is acceptable or if you need us to provide any additional evidence ahead of execution. If we don’t hear back we will proceed with the standard attestation and notify you immediately when the maintenance completes.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: HealthSync Legal <legal@healthsync.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@healthsync.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:14:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Interim geo-escrow notice — temporary outbound hop and evidence timeline

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the notice. A few clarifying questions before we sign off: 

1) Data types: when you say PII is redacted, can you confirm which fields are redacted vs hashed? We need a short field map showing what leaves the EU in any form.
2) KMS/Encryption: will keys be accessed in the US region for this window or are all decrypt operations performed within the EU prior to hop?
3) Persistence: you indicate nothing persists beyond the window — please confirm that any replicas or caches in the US will be flushed and that you can provide a tamper-evident log showing deletion/flush events.
4) Subprocessors: if you rely on any third parties for the analytics cluster in the US, we need an emergency subprocessor roster for that specific maintenance window.
5) Governance: HealthSync requires a named Redwood contact and a post-window attestation document signed by an authorized Redwood representative.

We appreciate the detail in the runbook; I can review the routing diagram but will need the field map and the KMS answer before legal can approve.

Regards,
Helen Park
Deputy General Counsel, HealthSync
legal@healthsync.com

Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Interim geo-escrow notice — temporary outbound hop and evidence timeline

Folks — forwarding HealthSync legal's questions. Suggested owner matrix below so we can turn around the asks within HealthSync's timeline (EOD Tue 6/2):

Action items:
- Kimberly (Legal Ops): provide a short subprocessor roster scoped to the US analytics cluster and any contractors who might touch the telemetry during the window.
- Jonas (Privacy): prepare a 1-page field map that calls out exactly what is hashed vs redacted and confirms no full identifiers leave the EU.
- Security/SRE (assign): confirm KMS flow — whether decrypt occurs in EU or if keys are temporarily accessible in US; produce a written log-retention & deletion procedure for the window.
- Lauren/Marissa (Customer): draft the attestation template and the DPA addendum to send to HealthSync for signature (DocuSign).

I'll coordinate with SRE to get the routing-diagram and an ops sign-off. If anyone needs to push the window to avoid the sprint freeze please flag before EOD Mon 6/4.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim geo-escrow notice — temporary outbound hop and evidence timeline (attestation & docs)

Hi Helen / Emma —

Thanks for the questions — we pulled together the items below per your checklist. Please find the attached artifacts and links: 

- Field map: attached in the doc labelled "pinning_addendum_draft.docx" (section 2) — summary: only hashed session identifiers and non-PII telemetry go to the US analytics cluster. No raw PII fields (name, email, full-text user prompts) are transmitted during the window.
- KMS: all decrypt operations for customer payloads occur within the EU. The US hop exclusively carries pre-hashed telemetry. No key material is exported.
- Persistence/flush: SRE will run a scripted flush at window close; we will provide the deletion events as a tamper-evident log (signed SHA256 hash of deletion manifest) within 24 hours.
- Subprocessors: attached roster (see pinning_addendum_draft.docx, appendix A) — third parties supporting the US analytics cluster are listed with contact emails.
- Named contact & attestation: I will be the named Redwood signatory; we have prepared a short attestation template and the DPA addendum in DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/HS-4382-addendum

Attachments: ops-runbook.pdf, routing-diagram.png, pinning_addendum_draft.docx

Next steps:
1) Helen — if the field map and the KMS confirmation look good please sign the DocuSign addendum.
2) We will perform the window and produce the deletion manifest; Marissa will send the attestation within 24 hours of completion.

If you'd like a 15-min technical walk-through before we run this we can make time tomorrow morning.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
